ImageDescription.value:
Cheering crowds line the streets as Cromwell tanks of 2nd Welsh Guards enter Eindhoven in Holland, 19 September 1944.
Eindhoven 17 - 18 September 1944: The people of Eindhoven line the streets of the town to watch armoured vehicles of British XXX Corps pass through. The 101st (US) Airborne Division had captured the town on the previous day.
